plainText:
Keira (Japanese: ミミィ Mimmy) is a character in . She is one of the judges of the Pokémon Super Contests. Her appearance is designed after the .

==In the games==
Keira is a member of the panel of judges for the Pokémon Super Contests. She seems to be friends with Johanna. When entering Hearthome City for the first time, the comes across Keira's , which is being chased by her . After reclaiming her Buneary, Keira thanks the player and asks them to visit her at the Super Contest Hall. There, Keira is seen talking with Johanna. She rewards the player with a Glitter Powder and wonders if they will be the next big Contest star.

===Pokémon===
 

===Items given===
 
 
 

===Quotes===
Hearthome City
"Oh, thank goodness that you happened to be there! If it weren't for you, who knows how far away my could have run… Baby Buneary , back into the Poké Ball you go! I'm Keira! I'm a Pokémon Contest Judge. Be sure to drop by the Contest Hall so I can thank you properly!"

Contest Hall
"Oh! My hero!"
"Wait! No! Really?! Johanna is your mom? So you might be a Contest star?!"
"Oh, yes, that's right! I need to thank you for earlier. Please take this Accessory."
"Put that Accessory on your Pokémon before a Contest. It will lend a nice touch of sophistication and glamour. I'm a Contest Judge, so come join us for a different kind of fun. If you're unsure of yourself, we also offer practice sessions. OK, Johanna, I'll see you!"

===Sprites===
 

==In the manga==
 
===Pokémon Diamond and Pearl Adventure!===
In the Pokémon Diamond and Pearl Adventure! , Keira appeared in Beauty Contest: The Pokémon Super Contest!! along with her fellow judges during a Pokémon Super Contest in which Hareta and were participating. She was not pleased with their performance in the Dance Competition.

===Pokémon Adventures===
==== ====
Keira makes her first appearance in Boogying with Buneary, where she picks up her Buneary that had run off earlier and punched in the jaw. She apologizes and makes up for it by giving Pearl a Glitter Powder. She and her Buneary appear again in Perturbed by Pachirisu, judging the Normal Rank Coolness Contest. She is later seen with her fellow judges at the Lost Tower after having been sent there because of the fight between and that caused time and space to distort.

====Pokémon====
 

==Trivia==
In the Japanese version of the Pokémon Adventures manga, Earma's nickname sounds exactly the same as Keira's name, with the only difference being that Earma's name is spelled in hiragana, while Keira's is in katakana.
